properties.text: Qwen Image 2.1 文生/图像编辑一体化

widgets_values: A cinematic widescreen 3D-rendered commercial scene shows a large ultra-thin flat-screen television placed at the center of a surreal outdoor viewing space. The television sits on a long, low, matte-black rectangular platform with a thin dark base, positioned horizontally across the middle of the frame. Its screen is a wide rectangle with a very narrow black bezel and a slightly reflective glass surface, displaying a vivid cosmic scene: a diagonal Milky Way-like galaxy band in warm gold, cream, and smoky gray, surrounded by deep blue-black space, bright stars, blue nebula clouds, glowing orbital arcs, and several planets of different sizes. The largest planet appears on the right side of the TV screen, rendered as a blue-gray globe with cloudy surface texture and illuminated rim lighting, while smaller planets and moons appear near the lower-left and lower-right areas of the display. The TV image casts a soft reflected glow onto the glossy dark floor beneath it. In the foreground, a dark fabric sofa occupies the lower portion of the image, with rounded cushions, visible woven upholstery texture, and soft shadowing. A single East Asian adult man sits on the sofa with his back to the viewer, centered slightly below the television. He appears to be a young to middle-aged adult with short dark hair, an average build, and dark clothing; his posture is upright and attentive, facing the TV, with his face not visible because he is viewed from behind. The environment around the television resembles an open rocky plateau or mountain amphitheater at night. Jagged mountain ranges rise on both the left and right sides of the horizon, with dark slate-gray rock faces, sharp ridgelines, and subtle warm highlights along their edges. The ground is smooth, dark, and highly reflective, mirroring the television glow and the orange light near the horizon. The sky fills the upper half of the image with a dense star field, fine speckled particles, and a dramatic night-to-dawn gradient: deep navy and black at the top, transitioning near the horizon into muted orange, amber, and pale gold. The overall palette is dominated by deep black, dark space blue, warm horizon orange, and screen-lit gold, matching the requested cinematic technology-product mood. The composition uses a low, eye-level wide-angle perspective with the television as the visual anchor, the seated viewer as a scale and atmosphere element, and the mountains and starry sky creating a grand immersive backdrop. The lighting is primarily emitted from the television screen, supplemented by faint starlight and warm horizon glow, producing clean soft shadows, controlled reflections, and a quiet, monumental commercial atmosphere. There is no visible in-image text, watermark, logo, signage, or decorative clutter.

横向宽幅电视产品商用 3D 渲染，超现实沉浸式空间场景，远景是深邃星空夜空，地平线两侧分布连绵冷峻山脉，天际带有微弱暖橙渐变光晕；画面居中放置一台大屏超薄平板电视，电视安置在低矮黑色长条形地台之上，屏幕播放浩瀚宇宙星河画面，星云、星球与蓝色光轨细节丰富；画面下方深色布艺沙发上，一名中国男性背对镜头端坐，面向电视观看，人物作为氛围点缀。采用电影级科技质感产品渲染风格，整体以深邃黑色、深空蓝、屏幕暖金橙为主色调，精准还原电视超薄窄边框、高通透屏幕玻璃、哑光黑色地台、布艺沙发肌理、岩石山脉硬朗质感，光滑高反光深色地坪能够微弱反射电视屏幕光线，星空背景带有细腻星点粒子效果，明暗对比强烈，氛围感静谧宏大。主光源来自电视屏幕，屏幕画面向外释放柔和漫射光，在地面形成淡淡的反光，环境为弱星光环境光，山脉轮廓在夜色中层次分明，阴影干净柔和，无杂乱反光。超写实 8K 数码家电商用宽幅渲染，横向全景构图，平视机位，视觉重心落在中间大屏电视，采用 35mm 广角镜头拍摄，精细刻画电视边框金属质感、屏幕宇宙画面细节、地面反光质感、山脉岩石纹理、沙发布料细节，低饱和度电影调色，画面内无任何文字、水印与 LOGO 图案。成品照片级星空山景大屏电视观影商用 3D 渲染，背景为布满细碎星点的深邃黑夜天空，地平线左右两侧是棱角分明的暗色山脉，天际线泛起淡淡的暖橙微光，地面为光滑深色反光地坪；画面中心黑色长地台上摆放大屏电视，屏幕展示震撼宇宙星云图景，前景深色沙发上坐着背对镜头的东亚男士，整体空间空旷简约，没有多余杂物装饰，全部画面区域不存在水印、文字、LOGO 图案。色彩参考：#070914，#172A48，#FF9F40，#417DFF，#12141A，#232735，#624A38，#253B59。
